'''''Plantago afra''''', commonly known as '''glandular plantain''',<ref name=BSBI>{{Cite web|url=https://plantatlas2020.org/atlas/2cd4p9h.hf7 |title=Glandular Plantain ''Plantago afra'' L. {{!}} Online Atlas of the British and Irish Flora|website=Plant Atlas|language=en|access-date=2025-07-20}}</ref> is a [[flowering plant]] in the plantain family [[Plantaginaceae]], and is one of a group of species in the genus ''[[Plantago]]'' formerly treated by some authors in a separate genus ''[[Psyllium]]''.<ref name="POWO"/> It is native to northern Africa (south to Tanzania), southern Europe, and southwestern Asia, and is locally [[Naturalisation (biology)|naturalised]] elsewhere, including north to Great Britain.<ref name="POWO"/><ref name=BSBI/> It has been extensively confused with the related species ''[[Plantago indica]]'' (branched plantain, [[synonymy (biology)|syn.]] ''P. arenaria'').<ref name=BSBI/>

== Description ==
''Plantago afra'' is an [[annual plant|annual]] herbaceous plant.<ref name=BSBI/>
